rows.title: WS3 — Build the demo H1: donor internals in printed shells, passthrough audio proven
rows.note: CAD for the demo rebuild (WS1 work; WS1 moved to next today): all 6 of Duran's 18 Nov changes done 20 Nov: band closer with shorter soft joints, bigger radii, rounded LED holders, mic boom fits, dual rear cable exits, biometrics placeholder. Ready for his review in H1 - Clean Visible Assembly. Also: stronger knob click, taller index teeth, band at a 7.3 mm cup gap, TPU stretch band trials. 2 resin cups printed 20 Nov; strap at sewing hub. Target 27 Nov.
